object_description: three-story main building with attached lower gymnasium and pergola
design_condition: The compact building is positioned as a solitary element within the campus ensemble, unlocking generous outdoor spaces and using tree rows and a play forest to define connections with the neighbourhood.

positive.statement: The comparatively small footprint unlocks generous outdoor spaces on the campus.

position.rationale: Open-space judgment is anchored to the building perimeter and adjacent sampled ground region.

positive.statement: The play forest and rows of trees create strong spatial elements and a connection to the surrounding neighbourhood.

position.target: play forest and rows of trees
position.rationale: Landscape elements are absent, so placement estimates the northern campus edge near the building.

positive.statement: The main building is clearly structured, and the atrium gives the interior a good atmosphere and daylight.

position.rationale: Central interior anchor follows the main building footprint and visible internal opening.

positive.statement: The large internal spaces offer circular paths and zoning possibilities, while the generously sized central cloakroom area supports a good atmosphere.

position.target: central cloakroom area and circular paths
position.rationale: Interior circulation is estimated within the central portion of the main longitudinal volume.

positive.statement: The large covered entrance area effectively serves the school and the two associated entrances.

position.rationale: Entrance anchor is placed at the lower building junction where the attached volumes meet.

positive.statement: The carefully designed floor plans achieve compactness while combining the volume with spatial qualities inside.

position.target: compact floor plans and spatial qualities
position.rationale: Broad judgment is anchored across the main building’s visible compact mass.

negative.statement: The ensemble appears somewhat random, and the proportions between the main building and gymnasium are not balanced.

position.rationale: The imbalance is localized at the visible junction between the main building and attached gymnasium.

negative.statement: The volumetric connection of the gymnasium seems problematic.

position.rationale: The gymnasium connection is clearly visible at the lower-left attached volume.

negative.statement: The terrace over the gymnasium raises unresolved questions concerning coverage, irrigation, lockability, and management during school holidays.

position.rationale: Terrace-related concerns are anchored to the gymnasium roof surface.

negative.statement: The playground equipment suffers from the edge conditions, and the break area functions more as a passage than as a place to stay.

position.rationale: External play and break functions are estimated along the lower campus edge.

negative.statement: The separation of the shot-put facility from the athletics area is not optimal operationally, and one entrance ends at the sports lawn, complicating maintenance.

position.rationale: Sports-area separation is estimated in the open site region beyond the building.

negative.statement: The kindergarten lacks recognizable addressing despite having three equivalent entrances.

position.rationale: Entrances are approximated at the attached lower-volume frontage.

negative.statement: Having all students move through one stairwell is suboptimal because the corridor zones become bottlenecks.

position.rationale: Circulation bottleneck is estimated within the main building’s central interior.

negative.statement: One of the internal spaces is insufficiently exposed and therefore less attractive.

position.rationale: An interior room is approximated inside the less exposed central building zone.

negative.statement: The gridded facade gives little indication of how the school building should work as a whole.

position.rationale: Regular facade grid is directly visible across the elevation point rows.

negative.statement: Statements about surface-water seepage and green roofs are missing.

position.rationale: This is a missing sustainability statement without a reliable geometric location.
